text:
A precision ranged fighter who manages focus to fire powerful shots.

Primary: DEX | Secondary: WIS

MP mechanic: MP regenerates passively from DEX+WIS+gear - all bow skills and spells cost MP. Run out of focus and your shots fail.

Skills:
Arrow Shot (Assail) - basic bow attack
Arrowstep - short dash
Focus - self buff, accuracy + damage (evolving)

Spells:
Pinpoint Shot - heavy single target, briefly stuns
Flechette - piercing arrow that bounces to nearby enemies (evolving)
Warden's Net - root/slow, evolves into a small AoE snare (evolving)
Gravity Arrow - pulls nearby enemies toward the impact point
Spotter's Brand - marks an enemy, boosts crit chance against them
Moonfall - delayed celestial strike on multiple enemies (evolving)
Valkor's Volley - sustained rain of arrows on an area (evolving)
Fulmination - lightning arrow that pierces a whole line
Multishot - rapid multi-hit on a single target

Passives:
Eagle Eye - more damage the farther the shot traveled
Phantom Quiver - every 4th shot conjures a bonus spectral arrow
Windrunner - Arrowstep empowers your next shot
